tagline: A bakery and café serving more than 300 kinds of baked goods, made fresh in-store every single day.

about.intro: Since our launch, Bakerz Bite has grown into a neighbourhood bakery and café built on one stubborn idea: that good baking cannot be rushed and should never be faked.
about.story: We bake everything in-store, every morning, starting at four. Our sourdough starter is older than our second shop. Our croissant dough is folded over three days. Nothing arrives frozen on a lorry, and nothing sits overnight pretending to be fresh.
about.promise: We only use real butter, fresh cream and unbleached flour. We treat our customers as family, and we will not use an ingredient we would not want to feed our own.

values.title: Real ingredients
values.text: Real butter, fresh dairy cream and unbleached flour. No margarine, no hydrogenated fat, no artificial colouring.

values.title: Baked fresh daily
values.text: Every item is baked in-store the same morning it is sold. Bread left at the end of the day goes out at half price rather than back on the shelf.

values.title: Carefully sourced
values.text: Belgian couverture chocolate, Ceylon cinnamon, free-range eggs and seasonal fruit chosen by what is actually good that week.

values.title: Served with a smile
values.text: Our motto is not decoration. Every member of counter staff is trained to know every ingredient in every item we sell.

contact.note: This is a fictional bakery created for an academic eProject. All contact details are sample data.
